title: Pet heat stress early check
summary: A watch card for pets during heatwaves, car delays, evacuation queues, apartment outages, or smoky weather when animals cannot cool themselves reliably.
content: Core sequence: 1) Move the animal to shade or a cooler room before heavy panting or collapse appears. 2) Offer water without forcing swallowing and keep the animal away from hot pavement or closed cars. 3) Watch breathing, gums, weakness, confusion, vomiting, and refusal to move. 4) Contact a veterinarian or emergency service promptly when severe signs appear or cooling does not improve behavior.
materials: shaded water bowl labeled for the animal
cool floor or damp cloth area
carrier or leash staged near exit
written vet contact and animal description
